column2: Living among ordinary people may still bring him pain at times. But one day he will surely find something.
Why he was born, why he has been allowed to live... I believe he will come to understand the answer by his own strength.
O small star of the great light...
May tenderness and great blessings be upon everyone who lives there, upon all of the world I love...
Even after the cursed blood released Clive, he went on living in the night, ruled by the moon and the dark.
He could find no other way to live. But he no longer fought out of the unhappy feelings of the past.
He fought on to live, and for a future where people could live. Only the moon could still see him now, fighting fiends in the dark where no one knew.
Long years went by, and the lone shadow against the night sky became a legend; in the tales he was told of for ages as a hero who lived in darkness...
Irene Tirnag: the time that had stood still for her began to move again.

Her memories no longer tormented her, but to carry on her grandfather's will she continued her travels and her research. It was also a journey to learn where she had come from and where she was going.
On her long travels, in the people and the landscapes she met, she found a future that no book contained.

They were small things: the warmth of people, the beauty of a sunset. But to her, those everyday sights felt like the future she had to protect. She sensed that her grandfather must have found the same on his travels.

Time passed, and when the days of fighting chaos had become distant memories, she returned to the tower. She took a young fledgling mage as her apprentice and passed on the knowledge she had inherited from her grandfather, together with his ideals.
Even after she leaves this world, those ideals will surely live on forever.
Back at the tower, Irene seems to have spent a while thinking about many things.
Through the journey to save the world, she was drawn, like it or not, into things she had always avoided.
There were many sad events, and she must have suffered... But surely she realised something there: that she is not alone...
That if she wishes for it, something warm is within her reach...
She may follow her grandfather's will again and lose herself in the study of magic. What will she see at the end of it...?
I believe it will be a shining future.
Still carrying her pain, Irene finished her journey and returned to the tower.
Life went on as before, and alone in the tower she set out to master magic.
The old solitary life was no hardship for her, and she spent her days calmly.
As time went by, her fame as a mage slowly grew, and she helped many people with her vast knowledge.
